packaging_shield_recycled_matte_asa.structural_purpose: Indestructible outer transit exoskeleton. Sliced at 0.20mm with 0% cooling fan curves to eliminate internal contraction stress across the 100mm height layout, ensuring the interlocking side ribs remain perfectly vertical and parallel without warping.

retention_core_high_rebound_tpu.structural_purpose: Internal structural spring core insert. Printed out of high-rebound flexible TPU with thin perimeters to maximize mechanical elasticity, allowing the internal fingers to grip varied product cartridge diameters without cracking.
